We asked the volunteers to evaluate the generated headlines through the following five approaches: (1) Vanilla Human; (2) Vanilla System; (3) SP-random; (4) SP-individual-N; (5) SP-individual-F. We evaluated the headlines from three perspectives: (1) User adaptation; (2) Headline appropriateness and (3) Text quality. The grading scale ranges from 1 (worst) to 3 (best), and detailed grading standards are provided in Appendix A.3.

overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive framework for personalized headline generation with both automatic and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and consolidation of human evaluation details. The paper does not use LLMs as judges (only as generation models), and the human evaluation is well-documented with clear criteria.
